title: Pier 9

panels.shot: Wide. Grey-blue dawn over the docks. Sleet falls slant across cranes and stacked containers. A tiny figure (the hero) walks along the quay edge. A fog horn's sound lines cross the panel.

lines.text: Pier 9. Where the city guts its fish, and its debts.

panels.shot: Medium. Saltmen in yellow oilskins drag a fish crate past a burning oil drum. One looks up; the cigarette drops from his lips.
Close-up on the hero's hand. He drops the scorched tuning fork onto a fish crate. Ring lines in red.

lines.text: I brought their bell back. Let them hear it ring.

panels.shot: Low angle. Six Saltmen spread out with hooks, pipes and knives, lit red by the drum. The hero takes off his coat.

lines.speaker: Saltman
lines.text: Sandman's just a story. Get him!
